build.note: In-game measurement tested against source predictions the note takes from the 2.1.1.0 raw capture (GRM_/GBM_ modifier files, see WEAPONS.md 'Mounted and deployed recoil' in the research repo); the note cites no raw hashes and this draft did not re-read the bytes. Lead L108 (MountedPlus and bipod recoil operands) already has a receipt; this draft carries no record.leads entry so it does not overwrite L108's current status.

question: Does the camera climb of an automatic weapon (M277) and a bolt-action (PSR) on the firing range fall by the factor the deployed-bipod and grip-pod recoil tiers predict (amountMult^tier sum), standing against mounted, with no grip, a Bipod, and the PTT, QD and Classic Grip Pods?

sourceFacts.recordings: reference-data/Recordings/10232026/M277 Bipod/<weapon>_<grip>_<state>.mp4 (10 clips) and PSR Bipod/ (8 clips), firing range, ADS, 2560x1440 at 120 fps. Standing = fired from the lane; Mounted = weapon rested on the range counter (mount prompt taken). Grips NoBipod, Bipod, PTT Grip Pod, QD Grip Pod, Classic Grip Pod; the sniper has no PTT.
sourceFacts.method: M277: scripts/recoil-recording-track.py (track, summary): template-matching of the yellow '10' and '15' range signs against a reference frame before the first shot; shots from the XOR of the thresholded magazine digits; muzzle flash from the centre-crop brightness jump; single-frame template slips over 40 px removed. PSR: scripts/recoil-recording-track-orb.py (muzzle-flash shot detection, 4 per clip matching the counter 11 to 07; ORB-feature RANSAC similarity fit of the whole scene, RMS at most 1.4 px) because the template tracker fails on the PSR clips (about 2 deg camera roll and a brief zoom-out per shot; the bolt animation crosses the ammo digits). Units are pixels of the 2560x1440 frame; the ADS camera scale is not calibrated, so only ratios between clips are used. dy > 0 = camera climb.

assets.Common/Hardware/Weapons/_WeaponModifiers: amount exponent +10, variation exponent -4 (bipod on automatic weapons and DMRs)
+30 / -5 (bipod on bolt-actions; QD/Classic grip pods on PSR, M2010 ESR, SV-98, Mini Scout)

sourcePredictions.note: The _P30 and _P50 files differ only in the two amount operands (Field_4692836a 0x08 against 0x0a); the Bolt file has 0x1e and variation 0xfffffffb. Recoil/GRM_MountedHorizontal and GRM_MountedVertical carry identity operands and zero tier deltas. Grip pods also bind Recoil/GRM_Recoil_BTM_P20 (+2 amount tiers) unconditionally. These are the note's statements of the serialized values; the deployed condition is Field_b574fa40 (BenefittingFromBipod header flag).
sourcePredictions.siteInputs: M277 ADS amountMult 0.9433, dirVarMult 0.921523; PSR ADS amountMult 0.94, dirVarMult 0.920371.

m277.clipTable: first 20 shots of each 21-round magazine; columns shots, spikes removed, first kick, median kick shots 2+, mean kick 2+, climb before shot 5/10/15/20 (px)

ratiosOfClimbBeforeShot20.reference: mean of the two no-grip standing clips, 126.1 (91.0 before shot 10)

m277.medianKick: Median per-shot kick (shots 2 to 20): no-grip standing 7.0 / 7.5; grip pods standing 9.6 / 8.2 / 7.7; mounted without bipod 5.2; deployed 3.3 / 3.8 / 3.7 / 4.3 (ratio about 0.5 against standing).
m277.horizontal: The wall texture repeats at about 90 px and the right-sign patch slips by that period during bursts, so per-shot dx jumps are not usable; no horizontal-variation ratio is reported for the M277.

psr.table: four shots per clip; mean 15-frame peak kick (px), settled (px, mean dy over frames +30 to +40), peak ratio, settled ratio, predicted
psr.pooled: Pooled deployed/standing: settled 0.163 (predicted 0.156); 15-frame peak 0.305. The post-shot oscillation shrinks much less than the net pitch when deployed.
psr.horizontal: Within-clip SD of the horizontal jump 3.50 px standing against 1.81 px deployed (ratio 0.52, n = 4 per clip, weak); settled-dx SD ratio 0.44. The predicted 1.51x increase in direction variation is not seen; deployed clips are at or below standing. Sniper grip pods carry no undeployed recoil tier.

reliability: Mounted and standing states were judged from the frame (camera height, counter in view) and the file names; the game shows no deployed indicator in these clips.

The player's mouse input is not separated from the camera track; the no-grip standing clips agree to 0.2 px at shot 20 (argues against compensation); the 116 px mounted-no-bipod climb is 8% below them with no other control.
Per-shot kick is noisy (+-3 px) because recovery between shots is included; the cumulative climb is the primary measure.
The camera recoil layer is not the bullet recoil (open item in the recoil handoff), so absolute degrees are not derived.

inference: The deployed climb ratios (M277 0.53 bipod and 0.52 grip pods against 0.558 predicted; PSR 0.163 settled against 0.156) agree with the amountMult^tiers prediction for the deployed exponent tiers, which supports applying the deployed tiers (+10 automatic bipod, +8 grip pod plus the unconditional +2, +30 bolt-action) in the site's Mounted stance; the comparison is of the camera layer, not the bullet recoil (the interpretation lives in the research repo WEAPONS.md; the note itself is numbers only).

Standing with a grip pod measured 0.80 (0.85 before shot 10) against 0.890 predicted for +2 tiers, and mounted without a bipod 0.92 against 1.000: both are lower than predicted and are not explained by the note (single clip for mounted-no-bipod).
The predicted 1.39x (M277) and 1.51x (PSR) direction-variation increase when deployed was not seen on the PSR and was not measurable on the M277.
unresolved: Horizontal (direction-variation) effect of the deployed state: not measured on the M277, weak on the PSR (n = 4 per clip) and opposite to the prediction.
Why grip pods standing (0.80) and mounted-without-bipod (0.92) are below the predicted 0.890 and 1.000.
Camera recoil layer against bullet recoil; the ADS camera scale is uncalibrated.
Deployed state is judged from the frame, with no in-game deployed indicator.
